compatibility_statement: All four measured workload configurations and five layouts retain identical row/column permutations and complete serialized row payloads in v0.2.0. The integer kernel is byte-identical. Wall time was measured on v0.1.0; this compatibility check is not a second throughput measurement.
validation: Recomputed every two-trial median and throughput from raw trials; all cache salts unique within each case and all diagnostic task accuracies 100%.
scope: Both throughput demos are synthetic workloads served by a real RTX 4090 JEV-9B vLLM instance. Padding is intentional. No real-production throughput validation is claimed.
